race.comment: LA MORRA (6) relished the mile second up with a dominant on speed victory by 3 lens as fav in good time at Kembla Grange. Held in high regard by the stable and will appreciate this trip and further now. Go close.  ALL STAR (4) kept fresh and due for a change of luck. Held his ground to the line with the 57.5kg for a respectable sixth over 1800m at this track a month ago. Kept up to the mark with a recent Hawkesbury trial placing over 1250m. Finds an easier contest and expected to go close. CABBUCIO (10) has been a model of consistency with further upside fourth up. Caught the eye with a narrow third at this track and trip on October 3. Fitted with a 1000m tick over trial and gets every chance again with Keatings' 3kg claim. VETWELVE (8) indicated he was near his best with a handy on speed fifth over 1400m at Rosehill in BM72 class. Ready for the trip and can do a lot better.
